title: Arresting Palpatine
description: Four Jedi Masters attempted to arrest Supreme Chancellor Palpatine after discovering the true identity and dark intent of the man they once considered an ally. But Palpatine was ready for them, hurling himself at his stunned enemies with the force of a hurricane. Although Agen Kolar, Kit Fisto and Saesee Tiin were slain by Palpatine's Lightsaber, Mace Windu managed to get the better of him...until unexpected interference from Anakin Skywalker enabled Palpatine to turn the battle around.
